name: io.github.peopleworks/signs-of-ai
title: Signs of AI Writing
description: Bilingual (EN/ES) AI-writing detection that shows the evidence, plus originality checking.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNSOFAI_API_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SignsOfAI API used by the two optional server-backed tools (measure_predictability, check_paraphrase). Defaults to the PeopleWorks-hosted endpoint. The four analysis tools never call it.
